name: Equipment Slots
description: Weapon/armor equip slots that modify combat stats when items are equipped. A run that crosses between regions tears the whole build down and rebuilds it, so anything a player earned has to be handed to the next build through a DECLARED input or it is silently lost — which is how an RPG hands back a fresh character every time you walk off the edge of the map. That is what the initial-state input below is for: it is the same rule economy.currency's startingBalance follows, and it is a request's business to supply, never this component's to remember.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Upstream module named; no adapter written.

inputs.name: initialEquipped
inputs.description: What is already worn when the build starts, as slot -> item. A slot the current slotTypes does not name is dropped rather than invented, so narrowing the slot list cannot leave an item equipped nowhere.
